sentences.text: Anomotodon was an extinct genus of elasmobranch selachomorphs, a group of cartilaginous fish that includes sharks and rays.
This animal belonged to the family Mitsukurinidae, whose only living relative is the pink goblin shark.
Fossils indicate that Anomotodon lived in deep waters between 1,000 and 6,500 meters down.
Its diet included squids, crustaceans, and mollusks such as clams.
The genus was first described by Arambourg in 1952.
Fossils of this creature are found worldwide and date from the Early Cretaceous through the Eocene, possibly extending into the Oligocene.
Its specific time range spans from the Aptian to the Burdigalian, covering 121.4 to 15.98 million years ago.
